# Links and images

[Relative](docs/other.md), [dot relative](./docs/other.md#section), [parent](../README.md), [anchor](#links-and-images), [with title](https://example.com "Title").

Reference style: [ref link][ref], [collapsed][], [shortcut].

[ref]: https://example.com/ref
[collapsed]: https://example.com/collapsed "Collapsed title"
[shortcut]: https://example.com/shortcut
